about: tools/showcase/redact.py: OCR terms blurred everywhere, plus fixed boxes [x, y, w, h, from_s, to_s] per still or clip (2560x1440). The personal terms (names, places, networks) are kept outside the repo, in ~/.config/tahoe-glass/showcase-redact-terms.json, and added at run time. The city, the weather widget, the Wi-Fi name and the login name and picture are shown on purpose (user, 2026-10-21), and so are notifications (user, same day: "dont have to blur the notifications"). File names and paths are shown too (user, same day: "the file name blurs are not needed"); what stays blurred: the user's real name (a private term), the password field (on the lock clips) and the user's own windows on other workspaces (the boxes here).
